text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kastam (Larangan Mengenai
Import) (Pindaan) (No. 2) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Mac 2019.

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

2.        Perintah Kastam (Larangan Mengenai Import) 201 7 [P.U. (A) 103/2017], yang
disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda  dalam Bahagian I Jadual Ke dua,
berhubung dengan butiran 2, dalam ruang ( 5), dengan menggantikan perkataan
"Forest Department Sarawak and Department of Agriculture of Sabah and Sarawak"
dengan perkataan " Department of Agriculture of Sabah and Sarawak Timber Industry
Development Corporation (STIDC)".

Pindaan Jadual Ketiga

3.  Jadual Ketiga kepada Perintah ibu dipinda—

(a) dalam Bahagian I—

(i) berhubung dengan butiran 31 dan 37, dengan menggantikan
perkataan—

"For importation into Sabah and Sarawak:

(i) an import permit issued by or on behalf of the
Director of Agriculture for Sabah or Sarawak under the
Plant Quarantine Regulations 1981

(ii) subject to inspection and approval by the Department of
Agriculture of Sabah or Sarawak"

dengan perkataan—

"For importation into Sabah and Sarawak:

(i) an  import  permit issued by or on behalf of the
Director of Agriculture of Sabah under the Plant
Quarantine Regulations 1981

(ii) an  import permit issued by or on behalf of the
General Manager of Sarawak Timber Industry
Development Corporation (STIDC) under the Sarawak
Timber Industry Development Corporation
Ordinance, 1973  [Ord. No. 3 of 1973]

(iii) subject to inspection and approval by, in the case of
Sabah, the Department of Agriculture of Sabah, or, in the
case of Sarawak, the Department of Agriculture of
Sarawak and the Sarawak Timber Industry Development
Corporation (STIDC)"; dan

(ii) berhubung dengan butiran 38, 39 dan 40, dalam ruang (5), de ngan
menggantikan perkataan—

"For importation into Sabah and Sarawak:

(i) an import permit issued by or on behalf of the Director of
Agriculture of Sabah or Sarawak under the
Plant Quarantine Regulations 1981

(ii) subject to inspection and approval by the Department of
Agriculture of Sabah or Sarawak"

dengan perkataan—

"For importation into Sabah and Sarawak:

(i) an  import  permit issued by or on behalf of the
Director of Agriculture of Sabah under the
Plant Quarantine Regulations 1981

(ii) an  import permit issued by or on behalf of the
General Manager of  Sarawak Timber Industry
Development Corporation (STIDC) under the Sarawak
Timber Industry Development Corporation
Ordinance, 1973 [Ord. No. 3 of 1973]

(iii) subject to inspection and approval by, in the case of
Sabah, the Department of Agriculture of Sabah, or, in the
case of  Sarawak, the Department of Agriculture of
Sarawak and the Sarawak Timber Industry Development
Corporation (STIDC)"; dan

(b) dalam Bahagian III, berhubung dengan butiran 3  dan 4, dalam ruang (5) ,
dalam perenggan (iii) , dengan memasukkan selepas perkataan
"Forest Department Sarawak" perkataan " and the General Manager of
Sarawak Timber Industry Development Corporation (STIDC)".

Dibuat 11 Mac 2019
[SULIT KE.HT(96)669/15 -36/Klt. 18/S.k. 54/(5);  Perb. 0.9060/18 JL D.35 (28);
